desc: Trace RDMA Userspace Connection Manager Access Event. For Linux, uses BCC, eBPF.
r: rdmaucma - Trace RDMA Userspace Connection Manager Access Event. For Linux, uses BCC, eBPF.

This program traces RDMA UCMA(Userspace Connection Manager Access) events, This can be useful to analyze issues on RDMA CM.

Since this uses BPF, only the root user can use this tool.
<dl><dt data-o="">-h</dt><dd>Print usage message.</dd><dt data-o="">-D</dt><dd>Show debug infomation of bpf text.</dd></dl>

This is from bcc.

https://github.com/iovisor/bcc
